verdict.rationale: Retell documents a first-party Transfer Call tool that routes live calls to a human with cold (blind), warm, and agentic warm transfer modes, and function calling lists transfer as a built-in action. The pack never explicitly documents passing context (summary, metadata, or headers) to the receiving human; SIP header passing appears only for the End Call tool. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of context handoff during transfer, configuration depth for warm-transfer briefing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can escalate a live call to a human with warm or blind transfer, passing context along

citations.quote: Add the Transfer Call tool to a Retell single or multi-prompt agent to route calls to a human, with cold, warm, and agentic warm transfer modes.
Function calling lets Retell single or multi-prompt agents take real actions — transfer calls, end calls, book appointments, send SMS, and call external APIs.
